name: Spiritual Resilience
body:
Prerequisite(s): Sprig race, character level 3rd.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against death effects, negative energy effects, and necromancy spells. Additionally, when you use your Growth Surge ability, you gain temporary hit points equal to your character level for the duration of the surge.

Special: This bonus stacks with the Sprig’s innate bonus against death effects and negative energy effects.
